+def test_parse_clixml_decodes_code_units_and_preserves_other_text():
+    data = (b'<Objs><S S="Error">A_x000D__x000A__x263A__xD83D__xDE00_'
+            b'_x005f_ _x005F_ _x005F__x000A_ _x005G_ _x000_</S>'
+            b'<S S="Info">ignored</S><S S="Error">tail</S></Objs>')
+    expected = 'A\r\n\u263a\U0001f600_ _x005F_ _\n _x005G_ _x000_tail'.encode()
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == expected
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_empty_entries_and_block_boundaries():
+    data = (b'<Objs><S S="Error"/><S S="Info">ignored</S></Objs>'

+            b'<Objs><S S="Info">ignored</S></Objs>'
+            b'<Objs><S S="Error">third</S></Objs>')
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == b'firstsecond\r\nthird'
+    assert _parse_clixml(b'<Objs><S S="Error"/></Objs><Objs><S S="Info">x</S></Objs>') == b''
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_unpaired_surrogates():

+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == '\ud83d/\ude00'.encode('utf-8', 'surrogatepass')
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_surrogate_pair_across_entries():
+    data = b'<Objs><S S="Error">_xD83D_</S><S S="Error">_xDE00_</S></Objs>'
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == '\U0001f600'.encode()
+
